messages:
elena_security: Auditor Sam requested a compact SOC2 evidence bundle: recent RBAC change history (30d), KMS decrypt proof showing HSM protection, IAM snapshot at time of decrypt, and a short replayable runbook. Meeting set Wed 10am PT. Can we provide a demo without handing over live creds?

morgan_eng: Yes. Plan: produce a replay bundle with presigned objects. Bundle will include k8s rolebinding diffs, cloud KMS audit entries for CryptokeyDecrypted, key version metadata, IAM policy snapshot, and a verify script that checks hashes/signatures. No live credentials.

elena_security: Auditor prefers artifacts over live access. Good. Ensure PII redaction and a short sampling rationale.

morgan_eng: For RBAC deltas I'll pull from our audit index with a limited query and include sample rows. Example Splunk query (will include exact one in manifest):
```
index=aws_audit source="k8s_audit" eventAction IN ("RoleBinding", "ClusterRoleBinding") | table _time, user, verb, objectRef, requestObject | sort -_time | head 200
```

auditor_sam: For the decrypt proof we need: timestamped decrypt event, key id + version, protectionLevel (HSM), createTime, and an explanation of who approved the temporary elevation used for the demo. Also include the IAM policy snapshot for the principal that performed decrypt.

morgan_eng: I'll include output similar to: 
```
$ gcloud kms keys versions describe 3 --key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/service-prod
protectionLevel: HSM
state: ENABLED
createTime: "2025-08-02T14:12:03Z"
```
and a redacted CloudAuditLog entry for the CryptokeyDecrypted event.

jenna_ops: I'll stage the bundle to s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026-03-10-replay/ and produce presigned urls with 7 day TTL. We will also keep an internal copy for 90d in our artifact repo.

elena_security: TTL 7 days is fine. Make sure manifests include SHA256 hashes and an explicit redaction map.

morgan_eng: Added a manifest with file list, sha256s, the Splunk query used, and a one-paragraph sampling rationale (risk-based: targeted last-30-days around a key rotation and a spike in admin changes). Also included a CSV index of objects covered.

auditor_sam: Also need a mitigation note for a scanner finding: a legacy user binding on a KMS key flagged as low severity. Provide the fix steps and detection rule we used.

elena_security: Mitigations: revoke legacy bindings, rotate to a new key version with strict IAM, and add a detection rule that alerts on nonapproved principals. Include a brief post-mortem stub.

morgan_eng: Included mitigation checklist and sample commands: 
```
# remove binding
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding ... --member="user:legacy@example.com"
# create new key version
gcloud kms keys versions create ... --protection-level=hsm
```
I'll also include TODOs for automation.

auditor_sam: For the JIT approval used during the demo, capture the approval transcript or explain compensating controls if full transcript can't be exported. I need ticket reference and the approval window.

morgan_eng: We have ticket INF-3421 for the ephemeral elevation. I'll export a redacted approval transcript and note the exact time window and approver identity (redacted to initials) plus link to ticket in internal tracker.

jenna_ops: Uploading artifacts now. ETA ~10m.

deploy-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026-03-10-replay/bundle.tar.gz (presigned link expires in 7 days). Manifest at s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026-03-10-replay/manifest.json sha256:9f3b...a7c.

auditor_sam: Received. This is a good start. If I need a live playback we'll schedule a time window and have you on call. Thanks team :thumbsup:
